title: Pencil icon is too small in Area details on Android
description: The pencil icon used for editing area details is too small, making it difficult to tap accurately.
steps: Open an existing area by tapping on it.
Observe the pencil icon within the area details screen.
actual: The pencil icon displayed in the area details screen is small and appears to be undersized.
expected: The pencil icon should be of an appropriate size for easy visibility and tap accuracy.
